youtube_description:
We took our first trip outside of Florida to beautiful Jekyll Island on the SE Georgia coast.  It is a historic high end resort community.

It was a nice place. The campground was almost full in the middle of the week with lots of repeat long-term customers.

We are split on camping there. Rhonda loved it and I thought it was too much like a "resort" but I really enjoyed the bike riding and beaches (too cold to swim in Nov. for a Florida man) if forced I will go back.

TIP: you have to pay to get on the island - if you plan on staying for more than one day but are not leaving the island you don't "need" to pay for more than one day.  The toll collection is automated and confusing.  We just paid for a single day for a regular car not oversize vehicle.  The people at the campground said "don't worry about it" unless you plan on going on and off the island.
